title: Rewinding the Counter
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word and $p,n$ natural numbers. For every natural number $r\le n$, starting in state $3$ at the clamped input offset $p$, with a unary counter of length $n$, counter head at $r-1$ (as an integer), and empty output, the suffix-extraction machine reaches after $r+1$ steps state $4$ at the same clamped input offset, with the counter unchanged, its head at $0$, and output empty.
replaced:
For every $r \le n$: from the rewind state with counter length $n$ and counter
head at offset $r - 1$, exactly $r + 1$ steps return the counter head to $0$ and
enter the skip state, without disturbing the payload head or emitting.
